---
name: A transcript came out wrong
about: The words were heard but written incorrectly
title: ''
labels: ''
---

**What you said, and what it typed**


**Which language and which model** — both are in `nabria settings`, under
Engine.


**Your vocabulary prompt**, if you set one. Its contents change the output
more than anything else in the settings, and a long one leaks into the
transcript.


**The audio, if you have it.** Turn on "keep the recording of every dictation"
in settings and reproduce it; the takes are in
`~/.local/share/nabria/takes/`. Without the recording there is nothing to
compare the words against, and no way to tell a misheard word from a badly
spoken one.
